title: What came between Bosnia (early medieval) and Kingdom of Bosnia?
question: What came between Bosnia (early medieval) and Kingdom of Bosnia?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Bosnia (early medieval) (838) to Kingdom of Bosnia (1377): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
